facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: high potential incident during a statutory inspection on HO-9401

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on HO-9401 and M-9401 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining lifting appliances, specifically proof testing and periodic inspection of hoists. HO-9401 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 5 May 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on HO-9401 and M-9401 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a statutory inspection; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
